programs.title: Abandoned Engineering: Season 13
programs.desc: There are many engineering projects in the world that have been abandoned for various reasons.The creators of the program present the stories of these structures and the people who created them.Behind each of them there is a fascinating and unique story.Viewers will discover the most spectacular examples of abandoned buildings from around the globe, including an underground Nazi base in France, designed to attack London, and a secret Japanese facility.We will find out why they were created and what led to their fall.

programs.title: Megastructures: Sagrada Familia
programs.desc: The story of the famous Art Nouveau church in Barcelona, ​​whose construction began in 1882.According to assumptions, it is to be completed in 2026.It will then become the tallest religious building in the world.The first architect was Francisco de Paula Villar, but he was replaced by Antoni Gaudi.He enlarged the size of the temple and gave it an unprecedented form.The Catalan devoted 43 years of his life to his work.Before his death, he managed to finish only one of the three designed facades.During the work, a special stone of appropriate color and high durability is used.The program will present not only the details of the project.Viewers also meet members of the construction team.They will be accompanied by, among others:crane operators who move huge fragments of structures with admirable precision.

programs.title: Megastructures: Real Madrid Super Stadium
programs.desc: The authors will show what the renovation of the legendary building looks like.Santiago Bernabeu is to gain a futuristic façade, a foldable roof and an innovative system hidden under the pitch.

programs.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programs.desc:
On April 26, 1986, an explosion destroyed the fourth block of the Chernobyl power plant.The accident was caused by design defects in the reactor and errors during the safety test.It was the worst nuclear disaster in history.The explosion released 400 times more radiation than the bomb dropped on Hiroshima.40 years after the tragedy, its consequences will be shown - from KGB activities to military operations in Ukraine.There will be plenty of witness accounts that will shed new light on the dramatic events.The speakers will include:liquidator working on the roof of reactor 3 and journalist Wyatt Andrews, who was covering the information blockade in Moscow
Reconstruction of the first day after the failure.On April 26, 1986, an explosion destroyed the fourth block of the Chernobyl power plant.This is the worst nuclear disaster in history.The explosion released 400 times more radiation than the bomb dropped on Hiroshima.Facility staff and firefighters are trying to deal with the consequences of the accident.The midwifery authorities a few kilometers away in Pripyat tell the residents to function normally.Lessons take place at school and weddings take place at the office.Meanwhile, a radioactive cloud spreads over Europe.
